description: Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation - Notify the Motor Traffic (Public Service Motor Tricycle) Regulations
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation under the Motor Traffic Act, establishing new legal requirements for driving public service motor tricycles. The content focuses entirely on creating a new regulatory framework, including eligibility criteria, application procedures, and legal definitions, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary purpose of establishing regulations, and no detailed ministerial portfolio responsibilities are described.
